---
title: "Explore the models"
description: "Change a model assumption, inspect the data in three dimensions, and see what happens to a marketing decision."
---

Each page starts with a specific dataset, shows what the model uses, and lets you change one assumption at a time. The three-dimensional view is paired with numbers and a decision statement, so the result remains readable without depth perception. The source note on each page distinguishes observed data from a simulation. These are teaching demonstrations; the full notebooks fit and check the models.
